en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਸੰਖ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼, ਕਰਨੀ ਹੀਨ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 1 : sa(n)kh to(n) upadhesha, karanee heen

en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮਥਿ ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲ ਕਢਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saagar agam athaahu math chaudheh ratan amol kaddaae|

en.bdb: It is said that after churning the Unfathomable Ocean, fourteen jewels were brought out of it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਧਣਖੁ ਮਦੁ ਕਉਸਤਕ ਲਛ ਧਨੰਤਰ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saseear saara(n)g dhanakh madh kausatak lachh dhana(n)tar paae|

en.bdb: These jewels are-moon, sarang bow, wine, kaustub mani, Laksmi, the physician;

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਰੰਭਾ ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤੁ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: aara(n)bhaa kaamadhen lai paarijaat asavai amiau peeaae|

en.bdb: The Rambha fairy, Kanadhenu, Parijat, Uchchaisrava horse and nectar offered to gods to drink.

verses.gurmukhi: ਐਰਾਪਤਿ ਗਜ ਸੰਖੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮਿਲਿ ਵੰਡਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: aairaapat gaj sa(n)kh bikh dhev dhaanav mil va(n)dd dhivaae|

en.bdb: Airavat elephant, conch and poison were distributed jointly among the gods and the demons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਿਆਂ ਬਹੁ ਮੁਲੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰੁਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: maanak motee heeriaa(n) bahu mule sabh ko varusaae|

en.bdb: All were given rubies, pearls and valuable diamonds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖੁ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਹੁਂ ਸਖਣਾ ਧਾਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਰੋਇ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhrahu(n) sakhanaa dhaahaa(n) dhe dhe roi sunaae|

en.bdb: Out of the ocean, conch came out empty, which tells (even today) weeping and wailing its own story that none should remain hollow and empty.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gur upadhes na ridhai vasaae|

en.bdb: If they do not adopt the discourses and teachings of the Guru heard in the holy congregation.
